title: Night Out Photo Fade
description: Hosted social evening led by a photo of the venue that dissolves into the navy ground
useWhen: Archy hosts an evening at a named venue and there is a good photo of the venue's outside or inside.
notWhen: there is no venue photo (use `Night Out Illustration` or `Night Out Scorecard`).
guidance: Dates follow the house style: "March 12 – 14, 2026". Kickers and event names in title case (the design sets uppercase where needed).
Leave out any fact that does not exist (venue, time): its label goes with it and the layout closes up.
headline: the invitation line, one white block ("Pull up a chair, Inland Empire."), about two lines. The event page cover splits it into two lines by itself.
image-venue: a photo of the venue from the requester or the venue, never generated; its top part shows, the lower part dissolves into pixels under the text.
